title: Information transfer along the causal lightcone of a brickwork quantum circuit
summary: Understanding how local information propagates through many-body quantum systems is a central problem in nonequilibrium dynamics, with important implications for quantum communication, state transfer, and remote sensing. In this work, we investigate information transfer along a one-dimensional open chain of qudits, focusing on the task of recovering information initially encoded at one end via measurements performed at the opposite end.
